blocks.text: Protein tabhi theek kaam karta hai jab woh sahi tarah 3D shakal mein fold ho (mud kar apni shakal banaye). Kai beemariyan, jaise cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s aur Alzheimer’s, proteins ki ghalat folding se hoti hain. Structural biology se samajh aata hai ke folding ke pecheeda raste kya hain aur ghalat folding beemari tak kaise le jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne beemariyon ke naam ghalat spelling se chhape hain: “cyctic fibrosis”, “Parkinsons” aur “Alziemer’s”. Sahi naam cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s disease aur Alzheimer’s disease hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek naya virus saamne aata hai. Beemari rokne ke liye structural biologist upar ke chaar faide kis tarteeb se istemal karega?
blocks.explanation: Pehle virus ki satah wale protein ki 3D structure nikal kar us ke domains aur active sites dhoondega. Phir in mein se drug target chunega. Phir woh insani receptor parhega jis se virus judta hai (host–pathogen interaction), taake aisi dawa ya vaccine bane jo virus ka andar jana rok de. Protein misfolding ka mutala yahan kam zaroori hai, magar un host proteins ke liye kaam aata hai jinhen virus kharab kar de.

items: Structural biology proteins aur nucleic acids ki 3D structure atomic level par parhti hai: structure, kaam, harkat aur doosre molecules se rabta.

Chaar faide: active sites aur domains (HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, serine proteases); drug targets (SARS-CoV-2 spike); host–pathogen interaction (spike aur receptor); protein misfolding wali beemariyan (cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s).
